reason: The object unpack format supports rejecting a missing required member, but the fixed harness marks its only named member optional. The same blocker exists before and after the change.
finite_witness: Input bytes 00 7b 7d: variant 0 followed by JSON {}. The object reaches json_unpack, but the format {s?o} makes the absent data member optional.

scope_contract.reason: Object member requirements are part of the json_unpack format contract, and object unpacking is a primary operation of this entry.

feasible_trigger.reason: The input bytes can provide {}, a valid object without data. A required-member format would reject it, while the target's fixed format selects the optional case.

evidence.dependency_reason: json_loadb parses the supplied JSON bytes into the root passed to object unpacking.

observable_consequence.reason: The absent data member cannot produce the required-member rejection: ? sets opt, which suppresses the missing-item error, and the optional o path accepts the absent value.

evidence.dependency_reason: The o unpack path returns successfully when its optional member value is absent.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The other object call uses o to extract the whole root; it does not require a named member. The array call operates on arrays. The complete entry contains no other route to required object-member rejection.

evidence.dependency_reason: The whole-object o format does not check for a named member.
The named-member rejection requires opt to be false.

identity_preserved.reason: Both source versions apply the same required-versus-optional member rule to the same fixed harness call, so the obligation and blocker are preexisting.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Shows why the optional o lookup does not reject an absent member.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Shows how a finite input supplies the object.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: json_unpack rejects an object missing a member required by its object format.
coverage_witness.required_setup: Unpack {} with a required named member, such as data in {so}.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: For objects, the fixed entry calls json_unpack with o and with {s?o} for data.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: The missing data member never reaches the required-member rejection.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: The whole-object o call has no named-member requirement; the array call does not unpack object members. The complete entry has no equivalent route.
